input_policy: Old scenes retain exact prior 25 views and reconstruct top-8 VLM crops with the production area/bbox/padding rule on the exact frozen masks and their hash-verified registered RGB. The older crop pool has different SAM3 outputs and is not reused. Additional scenes use consecutive middle 25 cached SAM3 views and original production crops, selected by frame ordinal before naming/GT. Full frozen geometry and estimated trajectory retained.
scope: Fresh VLM inference plus fresh CPU fusion/backfill, from cached SAM3 and frozen geometry. Not raw RGB-D end-to-end timing. Object memory B only; A is the unchanged reference. No point ownership/class changes.

arms.A: All original crops, Qwen naming in parallel with fresh CPU fusion, original backfill.
arms.B: Fresh fusion then predicted-object crop grouping, at most 3 distinct representative views; if no 2-frame strict majority, infer all remaining eligible crops of that object. No calls for crops that cannot backfill or objects with fewer than 2 eligible frames.

representatives: Max mask_pixels*geometric_share first; then largest angular separation among crops at least half the best remaining quality. No GT/model labels used for selection.
cache: Cold per arm/run. No pre-existing VLM outputs used for measured inference. Preserve original source frame IDs and deduplicate votes. Cache namespace binds geometry, memberships, model, prompt and crop hashes.
evaluation: Seal all predictions before GT. Report call counts, actual post-SAM3 tail wall time including model process startup and lost fusion/naming overlap, peak GPU/RAM, all-array map parity, exact naming agreement/coverage and independently projected GT naming diagnostic where available. Existing taxonomy aliases fixed from repository, unrecognized names abstain; no GT-tuned thresholds.
promotion: Experimental only. No production pipeline change or claim of 3D instance accuracy gain.
historical_plan: Original 2026-09-27 plan is preserved in the recovery copy; this reduced A/B plan is for future runs, not a restatement of the original preregistration.
